schema.title: result.json — output of every writer (be-writer, fe-writer, test-designer). The conductor script branches on `status`.

status.description: DONE = all assigned tasks done and local checks green. BLOCKED_ON_DECISION = cannot proceed without an owner decision (decisions_needed non-empty). DISPUTE = disagrees with a review finding (dispute filled). DISPUTE_TEST = an acceptance test contradicts the spec (dispute filled, test_id set). FAILED = could not complete (error).

tasks_completed.description: script ticks these in tasks.md after the gate is green

files_changed.description: must all be inside the agent's write-allow roots — verified by script against git diff

assumptions.description: every default the writer chose; hard_list=true here fails DoD

rule_ref.description: AC-id / convention file#section / constitution article the writer relies on

schema_changes.description: be-writer in C3a; DESTRUCTIVE ⇒ conductor opens G2b
